ground_truth.rotation_frame: Saved final fixture raster. ROT01/ROT02 rotate pixels before writing and transform manually authored boxes into the resulting raster; synthetic rotation is not a metadata-only EXIF rotation.

ovis.units: integer coordinates in [0,1000), x normalized by input width and y by input height
ovis.rotation_frame: Coordinates are relative to the exact image supplied to the model. Harness applies EXIF transpose then composites alpha onto white before inference; fixture rotations are baked into the supplied raster, so compare to ground-truth boxes transformed into that same raster. No inverse transform to an earlier unrotated source is applied.

rapid.order: four-point quadrilateral; metric converts to axis-aligned envelope
rapid.rotation_frame: The installed 1.4.4 code restores word boxes through reverse crop/rotation and then maps detector/word points through preprocessing scale/padding to raw_h/raw_w. In this harness, raw input is the EXIF-transposed, white-alpha-composited raster; fixture rotations are baked into this raster, and ground truth is in that same frame.

comparison_rule: A backend without one of these source-supported frames is recorded unsupported; no IoU is reported for an unknown coordinate convention.
